title: Proactive schema sentinel for config & model rollout gating
creator: Alexa Chen
description: Create a lightweight, automated "sentinel" system that detects quality regressions in structured outputs (JSON/typed blobs) tied to configuration or model changes and blocks or annotates rollouts. The sentinel will run a compact eval suite against a golden anchor dataset and live traffic simulated inputs, compute per-field integrity and semantic deltas, and expose pass/fail signals into the rollout engine so canary percentages can be gated automatically.
acceptance_criteria: A compact anchor evaluation suite (<=200 prompts) runs in CI and in rollout canaries and produces per-field pass rates and a composite regression score
Per-field thresholds configurable per-model and per-route and stored in config; default conservative thresholds shipped
Sentinel emits a standardized JSON signal to the rollout engine: {status: pass|warn|fail, score: float, changed_fields: list}
Console dashboard tile for canary shows sentinel score, top 5 changed fields, and links to failing examples
Automatic rollback (or pause) triggers configured for 'fail' state; 'warn' state creates a pager and a rerun job
Telemetry stored in the evals bucket with versioned run metadata so we can trace regressions to specific config/model commits
notes: This is focused on structured-output regressions (schema adherence and per-field semantic drift) rather than purely embedding or scalar metrics
We must be careful to avoid false positives from expected downstream schema changes. Include a simple approval flow for intentional schema updates
Plan to reuse existing telemetry ingestion pipelines from ENG-16358 and the structured-output contract telemetry work
Keep runtime cost low: primary sentinel runs on a trimmed prompt set and uses lightweight comparators + heuristics before invoking heavier evals
comments: 2026-03-05 Alexa Chen: Created ticket after spike that showed config rollouts caused undetected field-level regressions in two customer apps. Proposed sentinel that ties into rollout engine.
